title: Kissing Students Cause Debate
synopsis: Public display of affection is not as accepted in China as in many Western countries. A recent photo of two middle-school students caused a lively debate online.

fullText.simplified:
学生接吻引热议

    这两天，有网友发了一张两个穿着校服，看上去像是中学生的男女，在公车站等公车时抱在一起的照片，引起了网友们的热议。
    有网友说，这还算好的。有一次我坐公车，看到有两个学生在公车里接吻，公车里很多人都看不下去了，大家都只能转头看窗外。
    有网友说，学生在白天当众秀恩爱，太不注意影响了。
    更有网友说，要是那照片里的是我的孩子，肯定被我打死。现在的中学生不仅早恋，有些还去开房，这是未成年应该做的吗？
    但是也有网友说，照片里的学生也只不过是抱在一起，时代在变，现在学生早恋并不奇怪。
fullText.traditional:
學生接吻引熱議

    這兩天，有網友發了一張兩個穿著校服，看上去像是中學生的男女，在公車站等公車時抱在一起的照片，引起了網友們的熱議。
    有網友說，這還算好的。有一次我坐公車，看到有兩個學生在公車裡接吻，公車裡很多人都看不下去了，大家都只能轉頭看窗外。
    有網友說，學生在白天當眾秀恩愛，太不注意影響了。
    更有網友說，要是那照片裡的是我的孩子，肯定被我打死。現在的中學生不僅早戀，有些還去開房，這是未成年應該做的嗎？
    但是也有網友說，照片裡的學生也只不過是抱在一起，時代在變，現在學生早戀並不奇怪。

raw.synopsis: Public display of affection is not as accepted in China as in many Western countries. A recent photo of two middle-school students caused a lively debate online.
sentence_translations: A few days ago, an internet user posted an image of what looks like a male and a female middle-school student in school uniform, ..
.. hugging each other while waiting for the bus at a bus stop, which caused a lively debate online.
"Once when I was riding the bus, I noticed two students who were kissing on the bus."
"The others on the bus couldn't bear looking, and everyone had no choice but to turn away and look out the window."
One user said, "Students showing affection in public are too inconsiderate about disturbing others."
Another user said, "If it were my kids in that picture, I would definitely beat them to death."
"Today's middle-school students not only start dating early, some even go to hotels. Are these things that minors should do?"
However, other users said the students in the picture were only hugging, that times are changing and students dating is really not that strange.
